name: kp-ai-challenge-monorepo
description: KP AI Challenge: Intelligent Healthcare Coordination Platform Monorepo

scripts.dev:portals: concurrently -n "HOSPITAL,BHU" -c "blue.bold,cyan.bold" "npm --prefix Hospital_Portal run dev" "npm --prefix BHU_Portal run dev"
scripts.dev:rescue: concurrently -n "RESCUE-API,RESCUE-WEB" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm --prefix Rescue_Portal/apps/api run dev" "npm --prefix Rescue_Portal/apps/web run dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "HOSPITAL,BHU,RESCUE-API,RESCUE-WEB" -c "blue.bold,cyan.bold,yellow.bold,green.bold" "npm --prefix Hospital_Portal run dev" "npm --prefix BHU_Portal run dev" "npm --prefix Rescue_Portal/apps/api run dev" "npm --prefix Rescue_Portal/apps/web run dev"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:hospital && npm run build:bhu && npm run build:rescue
